judged_text: In the plural branch of _hydrateEmbedded, obj[k].map is called with no null guard and the trailing `|| []` is dead code (map never returns a falsy value), so a *_ids key serialized as null by the REST serializer raises TypeError on null.map. Any model whose embedded has-many is serialized with a null ids array (rather than []) crashes the store hydration path for the whole payload, breaking the admin page that loads it; the `hydrated || []` fallback gives false confidence that the empty case is handled.

adjudication.rationale: In `store.js.es6` `_hydrateEmbedded`, the new plural-ids branch does `obj[k].map(...)` without checking that `obj[k]` is an array (`const hydrated = obj[k].map(...)`). This would indeed throw a `TypeError` if a `*_ids` key is ever `null`/`undefined`/non-array. Also, `hydrated || []` is ineffective because `Array#map` always returns an array. However, the diff does not show any serializer/path that actually emits `null` for `*_ids` (e.g., `EmbeddingSerializer` likely produces `[]` when empty), so the claimed concrete crash of the admin page can’t be verified from the diff alone.
